annotations.title: What does a procedure cost at hospitals near this ZIP? Cash price, gross charge and every insurer’s negotiated rate for a CPT, HCPCS or MS-DRG code at Colorado hospitals, normalized by Distill from the hospitals’ federally required price files

description: What does a procedure cost at hospitals near this ZIP? Cash price, gross charge and every insurer’s negotiated rate for a CPT, HCPCS or MS-DRG code at Colorado hospitals, normalized by Distill from the hospitals’ federally required price files. From the machine-readable standard-charge files hospitals must publish (45 CFR 180), parsed and normalized: for each hospital within the radius that posts the code, nearest first, the gross charge, the discounted cash price, the de-identified minimum and maximum, and every payer and plan’s negotiated dollar amount or percentage (with the v3.0 median, 10th and 90th percentile allowed amounts), payers canonicalized to a stable payer_id. Filters: payer, plan type, plan name text, setting, billing class. A summary gives nearest-rank statistics over the hospitals returned. Served states: Colorado. An area with no hospital posting the code answers 404 and is not charged. Updated weekly. Price: $0.02 per call. Free tier: 3 free calls a day per IP, at most 3 rows per answer, taken by an unpaid call unless its _meta["distill/free-tier"] is "skip". Confidence: Mean over the returned rows (each rate; an item with no rate counts once) of normalize × quality × freshness. Normalize: the stored per-rate normalize confidence (payer canonicalization: rule 1, model 0.9, fallback 0.6; rate basis for rates with no dollar amount: rule 1, model 0.9, fallback 0.75; 1 for an item with no rate). Quality of the MRF: 1 valid against the v3.0 schema, 0.85 parsed with conformance errors, 0.7 parsed only after header repair. Freshness: 1 while the MRF’s last_updated_on is at most 365 days old, then halving every 180 days (0.5 with no date), times 1 within 14 days of our fetch, then halving every 30 days. Posted standard charges from hospital machine-readable files (45 CFR 180): posted rates, not a quote; not medical or financial advice. What you pay depends on your plan, your care and the hospital. See /terms.

billing_class.description: Optional: facility or professional (items posted for both always match).

code.description: The billing code: CPT (5 characters, e.g. 99213), HCPCS Level II (a letter and 4 digits, e.g. J1885) or MS-DRG (3 digits, e.g. 470).

code_type.description: Optional: the code type. Inferred from the code’s shape when omitted.

limit.description: How many hospitals to return, nearest first (default 10, at most 50).

payer.description: Optional: a canonical payer_id (e.g. aetna, cigna, unitedhealthcare, anthem, medicare, medicaid). hospital.payers lists the payers with prices for a code.

plan.description: Optional: text the plan name (or payer name) contains as the hospital writes it, case-insensitive, e.g. "PPO" or "Medicare Advantage".

radius_miles.description: Search radius in miles (default 25, at most 100).

setting.description: Optional: inpatient or outpatient (items posted for both always match).

zip.description: A 5-digit ZIP code (its Census ZCTA point). Give a zip, or lat and lon.
